newsitem.title: USA: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs March index rises to 57.5.
newsitem.headline: Chicago Purchasing Mgrs March index rises to 57.5.

text.p: The Chicagoland Business Barometer rose to a seasonally adjusted 57.5 in March from 56.2 in February, the Purchasing Management Association of Chicago (PMAC) said on Monday.
An index below 50 signals a slowing manufacturing economy, while a reading above 50 suggests expansion.
The prices paid index rose to 57.4 in March from 56.0 in February.
The employment component of the barometer rose to 53.4 in March from 49.9 in February.
(* indicates components used to calculate index)

The Purchasing Management Association of Chicago said the Chicagoland business barometer showed that "employment jumped to the highest level since August '95," while "order backlog, inventories and employment set increasing trend."
It also noted that production and new orders each moved over 60. Supplier deliveries dropped back below neutral, giving up last month's gain, it added.
